text.en: Pet owners consistently remark on the attentive treatment their dogs receive across boarding, grooming, and hydrotherapy sessions. Reviewers note that puppies and older dogs alike are handled with genuine affection and patience, returning home calm, relaxed, and happy after short or extended stays.

Clients speak highly of the team, noting that groomers and kennel attendants treat every visitor with kindness and professionalism. Reviewers specifically mention team members Lee Ann and Margot for smooth booking arrangements and skilled grooming, emphasizing that the staff go the extra mile for every pet.

Dog parents praise the centre's expansive grounds and well-maintained facility, describing the premises as comfortable and secure for canine boarding. Reviewers appreciate the dedicated hydrotherapy pool and on-site grooming salon, noting that dogs have plenty of room to rest and exercise safely during kennel stays.

q.en: Does Top Dogs Canine Centre offer hydrotherapy for dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients report positive experiences with the on-site hydrotherapy facility for senior dogs requiring gentle rehabilitation.

q.en: Are grooming services available during kennel stays?

a.en: Yes, owners frequently arrange dog grooming and styling sessions alongside their pet's boarding stays.

q.en: How are boarding bookings arranged at the centre?

a.en: Clients note that booking kennel stays is straightforward by contacting the reception staff directly.

q.en: Can young puppies attend grooming at the centre?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention bringing five-month-old puppies for introductory grooming with positive results.
